description: This file defines the 'Entry' struct and associated methods for logging in the Logrus package, including functions for creating, duplicating, formatting, and logging entries with various levels and formats.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a log entry with fields for logger reference, data, timestamp, level, caller info, message, buffer, context, and error string.

methods.name: NewEntry
methods.description: Creates a new log Entry associated with a given Logger.

methods.name: Dup
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the log Entry with copied data fields.

methods.name: Bytes
methods.description: Returns the byte slice representation of the log entry using the formatter.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the log entry.

methods.name: WithError
methods.description: Adds an error as a field to the log entry.

methods.name: WithContext
methods.description: Associates a context with the log entry.

methods.name: WithField
methods.description: Adds a single key-value pair to the log entry.

methods.name: WithFields
methods.description: Adds multiple fields to the log entry.

methods.name: WithTime
methods.description: Overrides the timestamp of the log entry.

methods.name: HasCaller
methods.description: Checks if the log entry has caller information.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Internal method to log a message at a specified level.

methods.name: getBufferPool
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer pool used for formatting.

methods.name: fireHooks
methods.description: Executes hooks associated with the logger.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes and writes the log entry to output.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level with variadic arguments.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Logs a message at trace level.

methods.name: Debug
methods.description: Logs a message at debug level.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Logs a message at info level.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs a message at info level.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: Logs a message at warning level.

methods.name: Warning
methods.description: Logs a message at warning level.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Logs a message at error level.

methods.name: Fatal
methods.description: Logs a message at fatal level and exits.

methods.name: Panic
methods.description: Logs a message at panic level.

methods.name: Logf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at a specified level.

methods.name: Tracef
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at trace level.

methods.name: Debugf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at debug level.

methods.name: Infof
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at info level.

methods.name: Printf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at info level.

methods.name: Warnf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at warning level.

methods.name: Warningf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at warning level.

methods.name: Errorf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at error level.

methods.name: Fatalf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at fatal level and exits.

methods.name: Panicf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at panic level.

methods.name: Logln
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at a specified level.

methods.name: Traceln
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at trace level.

methods.name: Debugln
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at debug level.

methods.name: Infoln
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at info level.

methods.name: Println
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at info level.

methods.name: Warnln
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at warning level.

methods.name: Warningln
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at warning level.

methods.name: Errorln
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at error level.

methods.name: Fatalln
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at fatal level and exits.

methods.name: Panicln
methods.description: Logs a message with newline at panic level.
